newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel sells Cofira stake to BT.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel sells Cofira stake to BT.

text.p: Alcatel Alsthom chairman Serge Tchuruk said on Thursday that the company had agreed to sell its 25 percent stake in Generale des Eaux's Cofira mobile telecoms unit to British Telecommunications.
"We have agreed to sell to British Telecom. As you know Generale des Eaux has selected British Telecom and Mannesman as partners," he said.
Generale des Eaux chairman Jean-Marie Messier is due shortly to announce the company international telecoms partners at a news conference.
AT&T and the European Unisource consortium had long been seen as the favourites to link up with Generale des Eaux in its new Cegetel unit which aims to become the second largest operator in France.
